dct_description_sm: California as an island with jagged northern coast, interior mountains, and no place names. To north are Fretu ANIAN and Compagine Land.

From: Geographia artificialis. Sive globi terraquei geographice repræsentandi artificium. Authore P. Henrico Scherer, Societatis Jesu. Pars V. Sumptibus Joannis Caspari Bencard, Bibliopolæ Academiæ. Monarchii, Typis, Mariæ Magdalenæ Rauchin Viduæ, Anno M.DCCIII. : Atlas Novus exhibens orbem terraqueum per naturæ opera, historiæ novæ ac veteris monumenta, artisque geographicæ leges et præcepta. Hoc est: Geographic universa in septem partes contracta, et instructa ducentis fere chartis geographicis, ac figuris, cujus; Pars V ... Geographia artificialis; FOL.T., following [p.]218. 7 parts (pars) published 1702-10; reissued 1730-37.
Maps also labelled Fig.II and Fig. VI, respectively. Figs.I,III,IV,and V are small diagrams showing projections.
